symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word document of F2026C00512 (download_sha256 f94be9a1ba8fe6764e97c93b6f491d54faddf0a23b34d1d6e1912e292e35a21f, unchanged)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() dropped characters Word writes as Symbol-font w:sym elements. cth_convert_sym_v8.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0B7 •, F0BE —, F0B4 × and the like), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: A diff against the first deposit shows only these 22 lines changed (same 7,647 lines, 44 characters more), each one list bullet (Symbol F0B7 -> '•' followed by a tab) restored at the start of an item in the notes listing expressions defined in section 4 of the Trans-Tasman Proceedings Act: lines 4315-4327, the 13 items of the note to r 34.61 (Division 34.4), and lines 4450-4458, the 9 items of the note to r 34.81(2) (Division 34.5).
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: baseline-2026-11 does not encode Division 34.4 or 34.5 (rr 34.61, 34.81), so no rule, case, value or finding relied on the changed lines or changed; no encoding records the text hash
